D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Judy Chu leads by 44.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 115,923 votes; a one point swing is about 1,304 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +37.6 and D +50.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$3.7M cash against $205. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
